name: SYS: Save Your Soul
storyline: You are a prototype AI integrated into a robotic body and must escape a secret scientific facility. Left on your own, you’ll have to fight, explore, and craft not only your arsenal and tools, but also various machines essential for your survival. To succeed, you’ll need to gather ingredients and components scattered throughout abandoned complexes while facing malfunctioning robots that attack on sight. Analysis, crafting, and survival will be your only way out.
summary: As a prototype AI trying to escape a secret facility, you explore abandoned complexes, gather ingredients, craft weapons, tools, and machines, and face malfunctioning robots with no guidance to find the exit.
